candidate_responsibility: Measure web vitals, network behavior, and build output to identify bottlenecks and sustained optimizations.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.

fusion_rules.rule: Measure web vitals, network behavior, and build output to identify bottlenecks and sustained optimizations.
Accept only: A web application, controlled sampling environment, network waterfall, and build information.
Produce only: Performance metrics, bottleneck evidence, recommendations, budgets, and an audit report.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: A web application, controlled sampling environment, network waterfall, and build information.
output_boundary: Performance metrics, bottleneck evidence, recommendations, budgets, and an audit report.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 性能审计实证与收益量化核心准则：通过网络抓包与 DOM 校验事实并明确断言、确认资源完全无用后再建议移除、严格量化收益毫秒/字节并忽略 0ms 无效改动、对指标卓越（如 LCP<200ms）的站点直接认可无需过度优化; Web 性能五阶段全景审计流水线：依次执行性能冷加载 Trace 抓取、Core Web Vitals 洞察解析（含 CLS 元凶）、网络请求全链路分析、无障碍树快照与前端源码工程级打包分析; Core Web Vitals 官方核心指标阈值标准：TTFB（<800ms/<1.8s）、FCP（<1.8s/<3s）、LCP（<2.5s/<4s）、INP（<200ms/<500ms）、TBT（<200ms/<600ms）、CLS（<0.1/<0.25）及 Speed Index（<3.4s/<5.8s）三档判定线
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 性能审计全流程的专业判断与建议过滤准则; 执行完整网站性能体检的标准操作规程; 量化评估网页加载与交互体验优劣的标准阈值
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 6 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (method=3, rule=2, template=1); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: Web 性能五阶段全景审计流水线：依次执行性能冷加载 Trace 抓取、Core Web Vitals 洞察解析（含 CLS 元凶）、网络请求全链路分析、无障碍树快照与前端源码工程级打包分析; 网络链路排查六大检查项：审查 head 内无 async/defer 属性的渲染阻塞资源、次级瀑布流依赖链（CSS import/JS 字体）、关键素材预加载缺失、弱缓存头、大体积未压缩包及无请求的废弃 preconnect; 前端源码与构建配置优化审查法：自动探测构建工具（Webpack/Vite/Next.js/Astro），排查 Tree-shaking 边界（如 barrel 文件与全量引用）、CSS 冗余清洗（Tailwind content）、Babel 垫片与 core-js 膨胀、静态资源压缩与 Source Map 泄露
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 执行完整网站性能体检的标准操作规程; 网络资源加载瀑布流与 HTTP 传输效率专项诊断; 拥有代码库访问权限时对编译产物与工程构建配置进行调优
